verdict.rationale: Hummingbird documents an inbound Alerts API that groups alerts into cases, and API keys in settings. Nothing in the evidence describes signature or HMAC verification of alert events, idempotency keys, or deduplication of retried deliveries. Grouping alerts into cases is an adjacent feature, not retry deduplication or authenticity verification, so the story is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a developer, I can verify alert-event authenticity and deduplicate retried notifications
